about_the_game:
Livestream the war. Don't die.
You and your friends are in New York City during a missile war.
You could hide in the bunker.
Or you could pull out your phone and start livestreaming outside.
The crazier it gets, the more your stream blows up. Get closer for more views.
Try not to die. One life. No respawn.

  • Pull out your phone and livestream the missiles & take selfies for clout, but try not to die.

  • When you hear a siren, RUN. You have 10 seconds to get to safety before the missiles hit.

  • There is no respawn button. Just like real life.

  • 1-8 players (friends recommended).

  • A bunker to chill at. You're safe inside. (Unless you didn't close the door)

  • Go outside, gather supplies, and bring them back to the bunker to stay alive during this missiles war.

  • Pull out your phone and start taking selfies outside. The closer the explosion, the better the selfie.

  • Pull out your phone and livestream the war. The crazier it gets, the more your stream blows up. Get closer for more views. Try not to die. Or do, cuz that might get more views?

  • Simple controls — bring your girlfriend and livestream the war together.

SIRENS — by RUIN THE FRIENDSHIP

Made In Israel.
